title: Calculus
tagline: The power rule, and integrating it back.

skills.title: The power rule
skills.objective: Differentiate powers of x and sums of them.

skills.title: Integration
skills.objective: Integrate powers of x, with + C.

levels.title: The Power Rule
levels.objective: Differentiate a power of x: bring the power down, and take one off it.

lesson.intro: A derivative is a rate of change. For powers of x there's a rule.
steps: A number in front stays: d/dx(3x⁴) = 12x³.
A number on its own differentiates to 0. No + C.

example.question: Differentiate 2x⁵
example.note: Bring the 5 down, then 4 is the new power.

levels.title: Integration
levels.objective: Integrate a power of x: add one to the power, divide by the new power, and add + C.

steps: Add + C: any number differentiates to 0, so it could have been there.

levels.title: Calculus Challenge
levels.objective: Differentiate and integrate sums of terms.

lesson.intro: Do each term on its own.
steps: Differentiating: each term by the power rule, and a number alone goes to 0.
Integrating: each term up one power, and one + C at the end.
Read the question: differentiate or integrate?
lesson.remember: A derivative has no + C. An integral does.
